cards.answer: Ekko is an AP assassin-mage with magic damage. He uses a dash and an empowered blink attack to engage, triggers bonus damage through repeated hits, and can rewind to heal and damage nearby enemies.
cards.counterplay: Limit repeated hits, leave his delayed zone, and avoid his rewind destination.

cards.answer: Z-Drive Resonance: Attacks and damaging abilities stack on the same enemy; the third stack deals bonus magic damage. Triggering it against a champion grants Ekko movement speed. The same target cannot trigger it again immediately.
cards.counterplay: Break off repeated-hit trades and respect his speed after the trigger.

cards.answer: Timewinder: Ekko throws a grenade that deals magic damage outward and on its return to him. It expands into a field that slows nearby enemies before returning.
cards.counterplay: Move out of the slowing field and watch the return path toward Ekko.

cards.answer: Parallel Convergence: A delayed sphere slows enemies inside. If Ekko enters it, he gains a shield and stuns enemies within. His attacks also deal bonus magic damage to low-health enemies, increasing with their missing health.
cards.counterplay: Leave the sphere before Ekko enters and avoid trading attacks while low on health.

cards.answer: Phase Dive: Ekko dashes, then gains extra range on his next basic attack. That attack blinks him to the target and deals bonus magic damage.
cards.counterplay: Keep your distance after his dash and expect the follow-up blink attack.

cards.answer: Chronobreak: Ekko's time-delayed afterimage tracks his earlier position. On activation, he becomes untargetable and rewinds to it, healing more based on recent health lost. His arrival deals magic damage to nearby enemies.
cards.counterplay: Track the afterimage, avoid its location, and account for his rewind before committing to a chase.
